instructions.individual_math_mode_desc: Enable mathematical font for specific nodes using the checkbox next to each node

instructions.karnaugh_3: After pressing submit, mark the needed implicants
instructions.karnaugh_4: If marking a rectangular implicant, click opposite corners of the rectangle in any order
instructions.karnaugh_5: If marking an implicant in a single row or column, click the beginning and the end of the implicant
instructions.karnaugh_6: If marking an edge implicant, click opposite corners of the rectangle of the desired implicant

byok_tutorial.title: Get Your OpenRouter API Key
byok_tutorial.subtitle: Quick steps to create and add your key for BYOK.
byok_tutorial.what_is_desc: OpenRouter is a unified API platform that gives you access to 300+ AI models from providers like Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and many others — all through a single API key.
byok_tutorial.what_is_desc2: Instead of managing multiple accounts and API keys for different AI providers, OpenRouter lets you connect to many of them using one key. They handle the billing, rate limiting, and provider integration for you.
byok_tutorial.models_desc: Access top AI models from one place
byok_tutorial.pay_desc: Only pay for what you use
byok_tutorial.howto: How to get your API key
byok_tutorial.step1_desc: Go to OpenRouter and log in with your account.
byok_tutorial.step3_desc: Click "Create key", give it a name, then copy the key.
byok_tutorial.step4_desc: Paste the key in your Profile → OpenRouter API Key (BYOK) section.
byok_tutorial.warning: Keep your API key private. If you think it was exposed, revoke it in OpenRouter and create a new one.
